verdict.rationale: LlamaParse is API-first. It documents a CLI, a REST API, and SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java. Code examples drive parse jobs programmatically, and webhooks notify on job completion so automation doesn't have to poll. Self-hosting on Kubernetes via Helm is also supported, which together fit headless, automated use. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD guidance (e.g., GitHub Actions or pipeline recipes), documented non-interactive API-key auth for CI, CLI usage details, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI runs.
